cases.situation: Got rejected after 4 rounds and a case study for a product designer role at a fintech; I really enjoyed the portfolio review with the team. The hiring manager, Lauren, was great throughout. I want to ask for feedback without sounding bitter.
cases.reply: Hi Lauren, thanks for telling me directly, and for how thoughtful the whole process was; I really enjoyed the portfolio review with your team. Four rounds and a case study is a real investment on both sides, so if you're able to share it: was there one thing that would have tipped it my way? A single line is plenty, and it's fine if you can't. Congratulations on the hire.

cases.situation: Tenho uma pequena agência em Lisboa. Fizemos proposta para o rebranding de uma rede de padarias e escolheram outra agência. O contacto era o Rui, diretor de marketing, que nos deu um briefing muito claro.
cases.reply: Olá Rui, obrigada pela decisão e pelo briefing tão claro ao longo do processo. Se puder, gostava de saber se pesou mais o preço, a abordagem ou o encaixe, para apresentarmos melhor da próxima vez. Uma palavra chega. E se o projeto precisar de reforço mais à frente, estamos por cá.
cases.note: Uma pergunta estreita e barata de responder tem mais hipóteses de receber resposta do que «tem algum feedback?».

cases.situation: Final interview for an ops manager role at Larkfield General Hospital on Sept 10. Recruiter Dev said I'd hear by the 18th. Nothing. I sent a check-in on the 23rd, still nothing.
cases.reply: Hi Dev, I'll take the silence as a no and close this on my end. Thanks for the conversations, and I'm open to talking again if anything changes.
cases.note: This is the second and last touch. Then stop; if they come back months later, you can still say yes.

cases.situation: 公司内部竞聘组长，我进了最后一轮但没选上，选了同组的小周。部门领导李总昨天花了半小时当面跟我说的结果，面试时他问得很细。我以后还要天天跟他们一起工作。
cases.reply: 李总，谢谢您昨天专门抽半小时当面跟我说结果，面试时您问得很细，我也收获不少。结果我接受，小周当组长我会全力配合。想请您帮个小忙：下次再有类似机会，您觉得我最需要补的是哪一块？您哪天有空花十分钟聊聊就行，最近忙的话不着急。
cases.note: 内部落选：公开支持胜出的同事，和请教反馈一样重要。

cases.situation: Rejected for a senior PM role at Tidewell. I asked the hiring manager, Omar, for one thing that would have changed it. He said my product sense was strong but my answers on metrics were vague, and they needed someone who sets targets up front. It stings, but it's fair.
cases.reply: That's useful, Omar, thank you for being straight with me. Naming the target and how I'd measure it before anything else is exactly what I'll work on. If the team is hiring again in the spring, I'd like another shot.
cases.note: Replying to feedback that stings: thank him, repeat the point back so he knows it landed, and don't defend the old answers.

cases.situation: 想申请明年的直博，给北大环境学院的周教授发邮件自荐，他看了我附的材料，很快回复说今年名额已经满了，建议我考虑其他老师。我还是很想跟他做土壤修复方向。
cases.reply: 周老师您好，谢谢您这么快回复，还专门看了我的材料。今年名额的情况我明白了。我对您组里土壤修复的工作一直很感兴趣，明年九月如果您组里有名额，我可以再给您发邮件吗？不方便的话不用回复。祝您工作顺利。
cases.note: 学术场合同样适用：谢具体的事，一句接受，只提一个小请求，并允许对方不回。

cases.situation: J'ai passé une journée d'évaluation pour un poste de commercial chez un distributeur de matériel médical à Lyon. La recruteuse, Camille, m'écrit que je ne suis pas retenu et me propose un appel de 15 minutes pour un retour. Je suis libre mardi 6 ou mercredi 7 octobre en fin de matinée.
cases.reply: Bonjour Camille, merci pour votre réponse et pour la proposition d'appel, que j'accepte volontiers. Je comprends la décision. Est-ce que mardi 6 ou mercredi 7 octobre en fin de matinée vous conviendrait ? Quinze minutes, c'est parfait. Belle journée à vous.
cases.note: Quand on vous propose un retour, la seule demande est de fixer le créneau ; pendant l'appel, écoutez et prenez des notes sans vous justifier.

cases.situation: I'm a freelance journalist. I pitched a feature on rural bus cuts to Dana, features editor at Northline Magazine. She replied the same day: 'Not quite right for us, but thanks for thinking of us.' I'd really like to write for them eventually.
cases.reply: Thanks for the quick answer, Dana, and for reading it. Understood on the bus piece. One quick question, only if it takes you under a minute: is there a kind of story you're short of for the winter issues? A single line is plenty, and it's fine to skip it.
cases.note: A pitch rejection: ask what they need, not why they said no. Editors answer that question, and it makes the next pitch land.

cases.situation: 9月15号在一家新能源车企面了产品运营岗位的最后一轮，HR王女士说9月22号前给结果，到今天一直没消息。想问一下，又怕显得太着急。
cases.reply: 王女士您好，想跟您确认一下产品运营岗位的结果，之前您提到9月22日前会有消息。如果这次没有通过，回我一句就好，我也好安排后面的计划。感谢您这段时间的安排。
cases.note: 过了对方给的日期几个工作日再问，只问一次，把“没通过”说成可以轻松回复的选项；一周后仍无回音就发结束语，不再追。

cases.situation: Founder here. Kara, a partner at Northfield Ventures, passed on our seed round after two meetings; her question about repeat purchase rates changed how we track our pilot. We'll have three months of paying customers by January, and she's raising a new fund. Her email said 'too early for us, love the team.' I'd like her to invest later without sounding desperate.
cases.reply: Thanks, Kara, and thank you for two genuinely useful meetings; your question about repeat purchase rates changed how we're tracking the pilot. Understood on timing. Would it be alright if I sent you a short update in January, once we have three months of paying customers? If not, no need to reply. Good luck with the new fund.
cases.note: An investor pass is usually a timing no: ask for one permission to update, tied to a date and a milestone, and skip the feedback ask.

cases.situation: My friend Nadia referred me for an analyst role at her company, Brightline. I got rejected after the second round yesterday, though I liked the team a lot. I want to thank her without making her feel bad or like she has to find out why.
cases.reply: Hey Nadia, heard back from Brightline, it's a no after round two. Thank you for putting my name in, it got me a real interview and I liked the team a lot. Please don't feel you need to dig into it or put in a word, you've already done plenty. Drinks on me Friday?
cases.note: The referrer is the relationship to protect: thank her, release her from chasing it, and take any feedback ask to the hiring manager instead.

cases.situation: I interviewed for Marketing Manager at Fernhill Foods and had a great conversation with the hiring manager about their spring launches. The hiring manager, Grace, emailed that they went with someone with more team management experience, but suggested I apply for a Senior Marketing Specialist role opening next month. I'm deflated, but I'd consider it.
cases.reply: Hi Grace, thanks for letting me know, and for thinking of me for the specialist role; I really enjoyed our conversation about the spring launches. I understand the decision. I'd like to be considered for the Senior Marketing Specialist position, so could you let me know when it opens? Good luck to your new manager.
cases.note: Take the pointer seriously but don't commit to a lower title yet; ask to be considered, then judge the role once you see the pay and scope.

cases.situation: I submitted a talk proposal to DevNorth, a regional developer conference, on how we split our monolith into services. The program chair, Elena, emailed that it wasn't selected this year out of 240 submissions. The conference is in March and I'm attending anyway; I'd really like to speak there one day.
cases.reply: Thanks for letting me know, Elena, with 240 proposals to get through. Understood on this year's program. One quick question, only if it takes you under a minute: was there one thing that would have made the proposal stronger? A single line is plenty, and it's fine to skip it. I'll be in the audience in March either way.
cases.note: A talk committee reads hundreds of proposals: one narrow question, and showing up anyway is what gets you remembered next year.

cases.situation: I did a paid trial shift as a line cook at Harbour Street Kitchen last Friday. Head chef Tom texted today: 'Thanks for coming in, we've gone with someone with more pastry experience.' I learned a lot watching him run the pass on that busy Friday. It's a small restaurant scene here and I'll probably cross paths with him again.
cases.reply: Thanks for letting me know, Tom, and for the trial shift; I learned a lot watching how you ran the pass on a busy Friday. Understood on the pastry side. If you're ever short on the line for a weekend or an event, I'd be glad to help out. All the best with the kitchen.
cases.note: A text rejection gets a text-length reply: one specific thank-you, one line of acceptance, and one concrete way to work together later.

cases.situation: 面了一家咨询公司的项目经理，HR林小姐今天打电话说我是第二人选，第一人选已经接了offer，如果有变化会再联系我。挺可惜的，我还是很想去。
cases.reply: 林小姐您好，谢谢您今天专门打电话告诉我，还让我知道自己排在第二，这对我很有帮助。结果我理解。如果之后有变化，或者团队再招类似的项目经理，希望您能想到我，接下来几个月我都方便沟通。祝团队一切顺利。
cases.note: 第二人选最值得保持联系：一句接受，只提一个请求（记得我），不问为什么，也不打听第一人选。

cases.situation: 上周HR陈女士电话口头给了我数据分析师的offer，说这周发正式offer。今天她又打电话说公司冻结招聘，offer撤回了。我还没跟现公司提离职，挺失落的，想回条微信保持好印象。
cases.reply: 陈女士您好，谢谢您今天专门打电话告诉我，也谢谢面试这段时间您的安排。招聘冻结的情况我理解。等这个岗位重新开放时，希望您能想到我。祝一切顺利。
cases.note: 口头offer被撤回：只提一个请求，不追问原因。以后正式offer签字前先别提离职。

cases.situation: Me rechazaron para unas prácticas de verano en un estudio de arquitectura en Valencia. La entrevista fue con la arquitecta Lucía Ferrer y estuvimos 20 minutos repasando mi portafolio, pero el rechazo llegó en un correo automático de RR. HH. sin nombre. Quiero escribirle a Lucía por LinkedIn para pedirle un consejo sobre el portafolio.
cases.reply: Hola, Lucía: me llegó la respuesta sobre las prácticas y quería darte las gracias por los 20 minutos que dedicaste a repasar mi portafolio conmigo. Entiendo la decisión. Si tienes un momento, ¿qué sería lo primero que cambiarías del portafolio para la próxima convocatoria? Con una frase me basta, y si no tienes tiempo, lo entiendo perfectamente. Ojalá coincidamos más adelante.
cases.note: Cuando el rechazo llega de un correo automático, la persona que te entrevistó es a quien vale la pena escribir.

cases.situation: I run a small IT support firm. We've looked after Hollins & Reed, a 40-person accounting firm, for three years, and their operations director Mark just emailed that after a tender they're moving to a larger provider from January 1. Our best moment was moving their whole office to a new building last year without a day of downtime, and we're on contract until December 31.
cases.reply: Hi Mark, thanks for telling us yourself, and for three good years; getting your whole office into the new building without a lost day is still one of my favourite jobs. Understood on the decision. If you're able to say, was it mainly price or the size of the team? One word is enough. We'll keep everything running as normal until 31 December and send you a handover plan in November so the switch is smooth for your people.
cases.note: Losing an existing client: the calm handover is what they will remember, so promise it plainly and keep the feedback ask to one word.

cases.situation: I applied to be a trustee at Eastside Food Bank, the local charity where I've volunteered on Saturdays for two years. The chair, Margaret, emailed that the board chose someone with an accounting background because they need a treasurer. I'm disappointed, but I'd like to keep volunteering and be considered next time.
cases.reply: Hi Margaret, thanks for letting me know, and for telling me the reason. A treasurer makes a lot of sense for the board right now. I'll keep coming in on Saturdays, and I'd welcome being considered if another trustee place opens up. Please pass my congratulations to the new treasurer.
cases.note: In a volunteer role you stay in the room after a no, so showing up as usual is the strongest reapplication.

cases.situation: 面了一家互联网公司的产品经理，最后一轮前做了笔试作业，花了整个周末写了12页的方案，交给面试官陈经理。今天HR赵女士发邮件说没通过，没说原因。这几周都是赵女士帮我协调面试时间，我挺想知道方案哪里不行。
cases.reply: 赵女士您好，谢谢告知结果，也谢谢您这几周一直帮我协调面试时间。结果我接受。想麻烦您一件小事：如果方便，能否请陈经理用一两句话说说我的笔试方案里最需要改进的一点？不方便也完全没关系。希望以后还有机会合作。
cases.note: 作业投入越大，越要把反馈问题缩小到“一点”，对方才愿意回。

cases.situation: I just finished a 12-week summer internship on the data team at Corvel Health, where I built the churn dashboard. My manager Ben told me on a call today there's no return offer because of headcount, not my performance, and said he'd happily be a reference. I want to thank him and take him up on that.
cases.reply: Hi Ben, thanks for telling me yourself today, and for a summer where I learned more than in any class, especially getting to own the churn dashboard. I understand about the headcount. I'd love to take you up on your offer to be a reference, and I'll give you a heads-up before I list you anywhere. I hope our paths cross again.
cases.note: When they have already offered something, the one ask is simply accepting it; save the 'keep me in mind' for later.

cases.situation: 面了一家物流公司的运营专员，面试官王经理跟我聊了一个小时，挺投机。今天HR刘女士打电话说，我的经验比岗位要求高太多，怕我待不久，所以没录用，还提到他们明年可能会招运营主管。其实我是真心想换行业从基层做起，但不想跟她争。
cases.reply: 刘女士您好，谢谢您今天专门打电话告诉我，也谢谢王经理面试时花了一个小时跟我聊，收获很多。结果我理解。您提到明年可能会招运营主管，到时候如果合适，希望您能想到我。祝一切顺利。
cases.note: 被说“资历过高”时不去辩解自己会待得住，只提一个请求，把门留给更匹配的岗位。

cases.situation: My former manager Rachel, who I worked under for three years at Copperline, is now a director at Quill Health and interviewed me for a team lead role. She called today to say they went with an internal candidate. We still get coffee every couple of months and I don't want this to make things awkward.
cases.reply: Hi Rachel, thanks for calling me yourself today; I'd much rather hear it from you than from an email. Going with someone internal makes complete sense, and no hard feelings at all. If another lead role opens on your team, I'd like to be considered. Our next coffee is still on me.
cases.note: With a former boss, protect the friendship first: say the no changes nothing between you, then make one small ask.

cases.situation: 我写了一部二十万字的悬疑小说，投给一家出版社，编辑周老师读完了全稿，还跟我通了半小时电话，她提的修改建议我觉得很有用。今天她发邮件说选题会没通过，说这类题材今年做得比较多。我在写下一本，也是悬疑，想以后还能投给她。
cases.reply: 周老师您好，谢谢您告诉我结果，也谢谢您读完了全稿，还专门花半小时跟我通电话，您提的修改建议对我很有用。选题会的决定我理解。我正在写下一本悬疑，写完以后可以再发给您看看吗？不方便的话不用回复。祝工作顺利。
cases.note: 退稿多半是选题时机的问题：谢她读全稿和那通电话，只提一个请求，不问为什么。

cases.situation: 我是一家做乡村图书角的公益组织的项目负责人小田。我们申请了一家基金会的年度资助，项目官员何女士发邮件说没获批，今年只资助了8个项目，我们排第11。下一轮明年3月开放，我想以后还能申请。
cases.reply: 何女士您好，谢谢您告知结果，也谢谢您告诉我们排在第11位，这让我们心里有数。评审的决定我们理解。想请教一点，只占用您一分钟：如果明年3月再申请，您觉得我们的申请书最该加强的是哪一处？一句话就够，不方便说也完全没关系。祝工作顺利。小田
cases.note: 资助落选和求职一样：谢具体的事，一句接受，只问一个窄问题，并允许对方不答。

cases.situation: Aldergate Foods turned me down for a supply chain analyst role after three interviews, which the recruiter, Hannah, had rescheduled twice to fit around my notice period. Last night I replied 'I'm surprised, I thought it went really well and I have more experience than most applicants.' I regret it and want to repair it.
cases.reply: Hi Hannah, I want to follow up on my email last night. I wrote it while disappointed, and it came across as a complaint, which wasn't fair to you or the panel. I accept the decision, and thank you for rescheduling the interviews twice around my notice period. I'd welcome being considered for future roles at Aldergate.
cases.note: Repairing a bitter reply: own it in one line, don't re-argue the decision, then send the gracious close you'd have sent first.

cases.situation: 我叫赵磊。上周二面了一家咨询公司的分析师岗位，今天HR张小姐发邮件说没通过。整个流程挺顺的，案例面试前她还提前把题目背景发给我准备。想回一封邮件，问问能不能给一句反馈，以后有合适的岗位还想再投。
cases.reply:
张小姐您好，谢谢您告知结果，也谢谢整个流程安排得这么周到，案例面试前提前发来背景资料，让我准备得很充分。如果方便，想请您给一句反馈，看我哪方面还需要加强。无论如何，以后如有合适的岗位，也很希望能再有机会。
赵磊
cases.note: 被拒后只回这一封：先谢流程，再请一句反馈，不追问原因；她不回也就到此为止。

cases.situation: 我叫何佳。上个月面试了一家咨询公司的分析师岗位，一直走到终面，今天HR赵女士邮件通知我没通过。整个流程她安排得很周到，每轮结束都当天通知我结果。我想回复她，顺便问能不能给一句反馈。
cases.reply:
赵女士您好，谢谢您告知结果，也谢谢您一路的安排，每一轮结束都当天通知我，整个流程让人很安心。如果方便的话，想请您给一句反馈：哪方面是我最需要提升的？这对我会很有帮助。以后如果有合适的岗位，也很希望还有机会合作。
何佳
cases.note: 被拒后只回一次：谢流程里一个具体的细节，请一句反馈，留个门，然后就不再追了。

cases.situation: 地方の食品メーカーの営業職で最終面接まで進みましたが、今日、人事の佐藤さんから不採用のメールが届きました。最終面接では工場見学までさせてもらい、とても印象に残っています。理由は聞かずに、お礼と、また募集があれば応募したいことだけ伝えたいです。私は田中です。
cases.reply:
佐藤様
ご連絡いただき、ありがとうございました。結果について、承知いたしました。最終面接の際に工場見学までさせていただいたことが、強く印象に残っております。また営業職の募集がございましたら、改めて応募させていただければ幸いです。貴社のますますのご発展をお祈りしております。
田中
cases.note: 理由を尋ねないと決めたなら、依頼は「また応募したい」の一つだけ。具体的なお礼が次の募集で思い出してもらうきっかけになる。
